name: Wake County, NC
findings: Wake County has 4,401 nonprofit organizations. 1,993 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,646 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wake County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 105 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 38 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 105 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
